68f518ddfa4b617f.summary: Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on consumer hardware with a one-click install for Windows and Linux, a local OpenAI and Anthropic API, and optional image input.
68f518ddfa4b617f.unique: One-click local inference of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, with a localhost API and optional images.
68f518ddfa4b617f.benefit: People without datacenter GPUs can run that Qwen model locally and call it through a familiar API.

7d5820b245cede35.summary: openTPU is an open-source AI accelerator from AI, with RTL, an ISA, a simulator, a compiler, and a profiler in one repo.
7d5820b245cede35.unique: It runs Qwen3, LFM2.5, and Qwen3.5 on a Kintex-7 PCIe card.
7d5820b245cede35.benefit: Hardware researchers can study or extend a full accelerator stack that already runs those models.

6d6576e058c67e77.summary: docker-agent is an AI agent builder and runtime from Docker Engineering.
6d6576e058c67e77.unique: The agent builder and runtime come from the Docker engineering team.
6d6576e058c67e77.benefit: Teams already on Docker can build and run agents in a runtime from Docker Engineering.

4503351927f0badb.summary: OpenShell is a runtime for autonomous AI agents that is meant to stay safe and private.
4503351927f0badb.unique: It focuses on a safe, private place for agents to run on their own.
4503351927f0badb.benefit: Developers who want autonomous agents can run them in a runtime built for safety and privacy.

02e3bf1928869cd7.summary: Jeeves applies reasoning to improve Jev-like decision models.
02e3bf1928869cd7.unique: It targets decision models in the Jev style rather than general chat.
02e3bf1928869cd7.benefit: People building Jev-like decision models can use Jeeves to improve their reasoning.

94596d73fc4d7609.summary: magnitude is an open-source inference engine for agents that compiles and tunes kernels on your own hardware.
94596d73fc4d7609.unique: It claims open models run up to 2x faster than llama.cpp on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, or CPU.
94596d73fc4d7609.benefit: Agent developers can get hardware-tuned inference without hand-writing kernels for each machine.

fac582e8d95d6d8d.summary: muse-gadget-sdk is an open-source SDK for building Muse gadgets.
fac582e8d95d6d8d.unique: It is specifically an SDK for Muse gadgets, and it is open source.
fac582e8d95d6d8d.benefit: Developers can build their own Muse gadgets with the open SDK.

00cc8b3f210885ee.summary: jev-chat-jarvis reads a chat, judges intent and risk, and drafts a reply you fill in with one tap. You still press send. It runs on Android, Windows, macOS, and iOS.
00cc8b3f210885ee.unique: Jev drafts the reply, but sending stays a human action across phone and desktop.
00cc8b3f210885ee.benefit: People who want a second look at a chat can get a drafted reply without auto-sending it.

addbab3545fa2844.summary: ZCode is Z.ai's coding agent harness, described as powerful, intelligent, and extensible.
addbab3545fa2844.unique: It is Z.ai's own harness for coding agents, built to be extended.
addbab3545fa2844.benefit: Developers using Z.ai can run coding agents through an extensible harness.

dd9680e2ccb138fc.summary: SCM does deep AI search over every photo and every frame of video in any folder on macOS.
dd9680e2ccb138fc.unique: Search covers both still photos and individual video frames in local Mac folders.
dd9680e2ccb138fc.benefit: Mac users can find a moment in a local video or photo library by searching with AI.

70cce2d5dd72d1ca.summary: magpie puts every agent's model in one menu-bar place, including Codex on DeepSeek and Claude Code on Kimi.
70cce2d5dd72d1ca.unique: You can point Codex at DeepSeek and Claude Code at Kimi from the menu bar.
70cce2d5dd72d1ca.benefit: Developers can swap which model an existing coding agent uses without leaving the menu bar.

2669f6afff388461.summary: AIHOT is a website framework that finds hot topics and writes its own daily digest. Swap in your sources and selection rules to make an industry news site.
2669f6afff388461.unique: The same framework hunts trends and writes the daily report once you set the sources.
2669f6afff388461.benefit: Editors can stand up an industry hotspot site by changing sources and what counts as worth covering.

791d0f1196ed364f.summary: universal-modder gives Claude Code skills, tools, and the fal MCP to mod almost any PC game you own, including recon, art, 3D, audio, in-game tests, and showcase videos.
791d0f1196ed364f.unique: It points Claude at a game you own and covers recon through generated assets and in-game testing.
791d0f1196ed364f.benefit: Modders can ask Claude Code to reverse, generate assets, and test changes inside a PC game.

b65ef539ee0e8b9a.summary: This dsh plugin serves frontier models, including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3, with no login, sign-up, or API key. It is completely free with no usage cap.
b65ef539ee0e8b9a.unique: Install the plugin in dsh and the models are available with no account and no usage cap.
b65ef539ee0e8b9a.benefit: dsh users can call DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 without an API key or a usage limit.

474bc088f594b095.summary: coucou sits in the Mac notch and on iPhone to watch coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity, and lets you approve from the notch or Lock Screen.
474bc088f594b095.unique: Approvals show up in the notch and on the Lock Screen instead of inside each agent app.
474bc088f594b095.benefit: People running several coding agents can approve a step from the notch or lock screen.

c9c14e440e7bf01e.summary: ldraw-nova is agent tooling for generative LEGO model building, built with Astra and Opus 5.5 and powered by Jev.
c9c14e440e7bf01e.unique: It applies Astra, Opus 5.5, and Jev to generating LEGO models.
c9c14e440e7bf01e.benefit: Builders can use agents to generate LEGO models instead of placing every brick by hand.

af09a051eb96e591.summary: ts-rust is an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript 7 compiler, tsc.
af09a051eb96e591.unique: It reimplements the TypeScript 7 compiler in Rust as an experiment.
af09a051eb96e591.benefit: Compiler developers can study or try a Rust port of the TypeScript 7 tsc.

fd00d19829252515.summary: shaders provides WebGPU components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, JS, and Framer.
fd00d19829252515.unique: The same WebGPU components target several UI frameworks plus Framer.
fd00d19829252515.benefit: Front-end developers can drop WebGPU shader components into the framework they already use.

9c51865a4ed52697.summary: omnirush-gui is a desktop coding agent with free access to frontier models.
9c51865a4ed52697.unique: A desktop coding agent that includes free access to frontier models.
9c51865a4ed52697.benefit: Developers can use a desktop coding agent without paying for frontier-model access.

01ebcf280c43e41b.summary: answer-me-with-html is an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML document you can read.
01ebcf280c43e41b.unique: The answer is a single readable HTML page rather than a long chat transcript.
01ebcf280c43e41b.benefit: People asking complex questions can get one HTML page they can open and read.

7d3465fad608c3c9.summary: invisible_playwright_mcp is a Playwright MCP server that browses on anti-detect stealth Firefox so agents are less likely to be stopped by anti-bots and captchas.
7d3465fad608c3c9.unique: It pairs Playwright MCP with stealth Firefox for undetected browsing, scraping, and computer use.
7d3465fad608c3c9.benefit: Agent builders can browse sites that block ordinary automation through this stealth Playwright server.

926fd02075a833c5.summary: jevgrep is a CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to find files and source context by asking what the code does.
926fd02075a833c5.unique: Search is by behavior, using Jev, instead of by exact text match.
926fd02075a833c5.benefit: Coding agents can pull the relevant files by describing the behavior they need.

9152bddf84242872.summary: logo-design-skill is a logo-design skill for Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex, and other agents, covering principles, SVG craft, testing tools, and a 1,400+ logo reference library.
9152bddf84242872.unique: It bundles process, SVG craft, tests, and a 1,400+ logo reference library for agents.
9152bddf84242872.benefit: Designers using coding agents can generate and test SVG logos against a large reference library.

d0439ac1933b8b01.summary: awesome-jev is a curated list of public projects, integrations, and discussions built on Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions.
d0439ac1933b8b01.unique: The list is specifically about Jev and typed decisions, not general LLM tools.
d0439ac1933b8b01.benefit: Developers adopting Jev can find public integrations and discussions in one list.

c37b68d1d42fcd28.summary: yomiyasu is an agent skill that rewrites AI-generated Japanese into natural Japanese.
c37b68d1d42fcd28.unique: It is aimed at Japanese prose polish for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and similar agents.
c37b68d1d42fcd28.benefit: Writers using agents can turn stiff generated Japanese into more natural Japanese.

3130059a986153ae.summary: big-arrow-on-the-screen lets AI agents paint big arrows, boxes, and text on a Mac screen from one CLI. The overlay is click-through and goes away by itself.
3130059a986153ae.unique: It is a Claude Code and Codex skill, MIT licensed, that draws on the screen without blocking clicks.
3130059a986153ae.benefit: People steering agents on a Mac can point at the UI without the overlay getting in the way.

6439c41fbb1f21fe.summary: reelmimic takes a video you like and makes a new video in the same style. An AI crew in Claude Code or Codex plans, builds, and reviews it with you.
6439c41fbb1f21fe.unique: The crew covers 2D animation and style transfer, and you stay in the review loop.
6439c41fbb1f21fe.benefit: Creators who want a look matched to a reference video can plan and review it with Claude Code or Codex.

38bdc84fd7878e9f.summary: video-demo is a skill that records video demos of a web app with zoom-ins and voiceover.
38bdc84fd7878e9f.unique: It adds zoom and voiceover to the recording instead of a plain screen capture.
38bdc84fd7878e9f.benefit: Developers can turn a web app walkthrough into a narrated demo with zooms.

35be46e698a587a6.summary: geo-sleuth is an agent skill that estimates where a photo was taken using OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery, and street view, and it shows its work.
35be46e698a587a6.unique: It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and GitHub Copilot.
35be46e698a587a6.benefit: Anyone geolocating a photo can see the evidence the agent used, not only a guess.

0fb55ef66f9ce5d2.summary: lemo-opuscar is a Claude Code skill for short films with no video model: 43 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made in code by Claude Opus 5.5, including OPUSCAR 98.
0fb55ef66f9ce5d2.unique: Films are built in code rather than with a video model, with a director and technical guide.
0fb55ef66f9ce5d2.benefit: People making short films in Claude Code can start from those 43 coded style demos.

74a90c5a46b6cecf.summary: ClearAI is an ontology-first DSH agent preset. Evidence-checked research grows into a domain ontology you can browse.
74a90c5a46b6cecf.unique: It is a native DSH plugin built around an epistemic loop for scientific discovery.
74a90c5a46b6cecf.benefit: Researchers using DSH can turn checked evidence into a browsable ontology instead of a loose note.

1e32cba93e1dadbe.summary: inkloom uses specialised models for logo design: a brand-analysis model turns a business into constraints, typography and symbol models build the mark, and a composition engine makes lockups and clear-space rules.
1e32cba93e1dadbe.unique: The pipeline splits brand analysis, type, symbol, and composition instead of one general image prompt.
1e32cba93e1dadbe.benefit: Early-access users can get logo lockups with clear-space rules, not only a single generated mark.

77938a1c5b17b033.summary: replica-skill is eleven free Claude skills that clone an app: reverse-engineer it, rebuild it, test it for bugs, then fix what users hate. It is free and MIT licensed.
77938a1c5b17b033.unique: The set covers reverse engineering, rebuilding, bug testing, and fixes, as Claude Code skills.
77938a1c5b17b033.benefit: Indie hackers can point Claude at an app and walk through clone, test, and fix steps.

b1e41c350cf25adf.summary: nanoMuse is an open-source personal agent for phone and computer. It keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo.
b1e41c350cf25adf.unique: One named agent runs on Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and in the browser.
b1e41c350cf25adf.benefit: People who want one agent across their devices can keep it running and still approve irreversible actions.

9b5741cc5b868ba2.summary: aurelio-finance is an open-source personal finance app with an AI financial advisor that tracks net worth, investments, ETFs, cash, and debts on your own computer.
9b5741cc5b868ba2.unique: The books and the advisor stay on your machine, covering dividends and financial planning.
9b5741cc5b868ba2.benefit: People tracking investments locally can ask the advisor without sending the books to a hosted app.

2fa2385c3505d9d8.summary: llm-master is a full-stack LLM learning path and Chinese tutorial covering prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, MCP, fine-tuning, deployment, transformers, and AI programming.
2fa2385c3505d9d8.unique: It runs from introductory material through production practice and big-company interview topics.
2fa2385c3505d9d8.benefit: Learners who want one Chinese path can follow it from prompts and RAG through deployment.

554d6c430c3db6a8.summary: AnyJev turns any LLM into a Jev-style decision model with typed decisions and real probabilities, and it does not require training.
554d6c430c3db6a8.unique: It targets calibration and decision models, including vLLM, rather than open-ended chat.
554d6c430c3db6a8.benefit: Developers can get typed decisions and probabilities from an existing LLM without a training run.

966cf788578296ef.summary: Index-Translate is a multilingual translation model family.
966cf788578296ef.unique: It is a family of models for machine translation rather than a single bilingual pair.
966cf788578296ef.benefit: Developers who need translation models can start from this multilingual family.

a003d22870c20a96.summary: golive-skill takes an agent-built product live: hosting, database, domain, email, and payments on your own accounts. It is an open-source agent skill plus a zero-dependency Node CLI.
a003d22870c20a96.unique: The flow is detect, plan, approve, apply, verify, with no GoLive account, backend, or telemetry.
a003d22870c20a96.benefit: Developers can ship hosting and payments on accounts they already own, and approve each step.

dae5d2fbddceaca2.summary: typesafe-computer-use does computer use for about $0.0002 a step: OCR the screen, classify the next action with TypeSafe, then click. It runs on macOS.
dae5d2fbddceaca2.unique: Each step is OCR plus a TypeSafe classification instead of a large vision-agent loop.
dae5d2fbddceaca2.benefit: Mac users can try cheap computer-use clicks when a full vision model is more than they need.

2c648aa0ea2364e9.summary: oil-ui pushes AI UI design by exploring distinct directions, comparing them side by side, and refining against real screenshots.
2c648aa0ea2364e9.unique: It is an agent skill for Claude Code and Codex aimed at UI and UX design.
2c648aa0ea2364e9.benefit: Designers can compare several AI directions against actual screenshots before committing.

0d5cfc87e4dcad62.summary: ai-agent-handbook is a practical guide to building enterprise AI agents across their full lifecycle.
0d5cfc87e4dcad62.unique: It covers the lifecycle of an enterprise agent, not a single library or demo.
0d5cfc87e4dcad62.benefit: Teams standing up enterprise agents can use it as a guide from start to finish.

569e9268232dd0bc.summary: WeChatBridge is a native macOS tool that forwards WeChat chat history to an AI agent and to Obsidian in one step.
569e9268232dd0bc.unique: It is a Swift share extension for chat history, aimed at Obsidian and AI agents.
569e9268232dd0bc.benefit: Mac users can send a WeChat thread to an agent or an Obsidian note without copying it by hand.

739df77aef3ec866.summary: dscode is a DeepSeek coding-agent harness with a persistent shell, Ultra subagents, auto approval, Chrome MCP, and session telemetry.
739df77aef3ec866.unique: It is a CLI coding agent built as a DeepSeek harness, including code review.
739df77aef3ec866.benefit: Developers on DeepSeek can keep a shell, subagents, and browser tools in one harness.

acbfc8b6782f5594.summary: herdr-gpui is a native Herdr client for macOS, Linux, and Windows, built with Rust and GPUI. It shows terminal sessions, workspaces, Git worktrees, and agent activity from your local Herdr daemon.
acbfc8b6782f5594.unique: The desktop app talks to a local daemon instead of a hosted view of those sessions.
acbfc8b6782f5594.benefit: Herdr users can watch agents, terminals, and worktrees in a native app on their machine.

f7f7084046b4a510.summary: Intent-Router is an intent compiler for AI agents. It turns vague requests into typed IntentSpec contracts, and it can probe, ask, or halt before routing.
f7f7084046b4a510.unique: It is the input layer for routers and typed-decision models such as Jev and Laya.
f7f7084046b4a510.benefit: Agent builders can stop a vague request from being routed until it is a typed contract.

09b7d9e6fc379941.summary: ThinkWatch-Lite is a local gateway for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI clients on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It switches upstreams without touching clients, keeps API keys off relays, blocks malicious tool calls, and traces every request.
09b7d9e6fc379941.unique: Keys stay off relays, and cost tracking sits on the gateway rather than in each client.
09b7d9e6fc379941.benefit: Developers can change upstream models and trace requests without putting API keys on a relay.

870696629d61a9c0.summary: AgentVerse-OS is a personal cloud OS for a developer and their AI agents on one server. One command installs it on Ubuntu, then a browser desktop holds isolated workspaces with VS Code, Claude Code, and Codex, plus a store of 944 self-hosted apps.
870696629d61a9c0.unique: Access is only via Tailscale, with backups and updates included.
870696629d61a9c0.benefit: Developers can give agents a private Ubuntu desktop and a catalog of self-hosted apps without opening it to the public internet.

11d4aeca05fb4a33.summary: TypeLLM is a project for LLMs with type-safe generation.
11d4aeca05fb4a33.unique: It connects LLMs, types, and Jev-style constraints on what the model is allowed to emit.
11d4aeca05fb4a33.benefit: Developers who need structured output can look at generation that is checked by types.

bae66b4f1f180cf9.summary: easyread turns English papers into comfortable Chinese: local PDF translation, side-by-side original text, questions to an AI while you read, and reference management.
bae66b4f1f180cf9.unique: Translation stays on a local PDF, with Claude Code and Codex among the tools, in an Electron app.
bae66b4f1f180cf9.benefit: Readers of English papers can keep the original beside a Chinese version and ask questions as they go.
